<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Thunderous Landing](/Feats.aspx?ID=5538) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

**Requirements**
You currently have a fly Speed and are airborne.

</column>

---

You hurl away enemies with the force of your landing. You [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) and, if you end your movement on a solid surface, your landing sends out a shock wave of air. Each creature within 10 feet of your landing position must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or be [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet away. This is forced movement.
name: Thunderous Landing
requirement: You currently have a fly Speed and are airborne.
